rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a prehistoric human-like being, though it can also include early Homo sapiens.

example.english: The picture in the museum shows a prehuman holding a stone spear.
example.traditional: 博物館入面嗰幅畫，畫住一個拎住石矛嘅原始人。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 go2 fuk1 waa2 waak6 zyu6 jat1 go3 ling1 zyu6 sek6 maau4 ge3 jyun4 ci2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for an early hominin or ‘ape-man’ in an anthropological or archaeological context.

example.english: Archaeologists found stone tools used by a prehuman in this cave.
example.traditional: 考古學家喺呢個山洞發現咗猿人用過嘅石器。
example.jyutping: haau2 gu2 hok6 gaa1 hai2 ni1 go3 saan1 dung6 faat3 jin6 zo2 jyun4 jan4 jung6 gwo3 ge3 sek6 hei3

rows.note: Use this more precise term when referring broadly to human-like beings from before recorded history or modern humans.

example.english: The development of agriculture among prehuman societies is an important subject for historians.
example.traditional: 史前人類點樣由狩獵採集逐步發展出農業，係歷史學家研究嘅重要課題。
example.jyutping: si2 cin4 jan4 leoi6 dim2 joeng2 jau4 sau2 lip6 coi2 zaap6 zuk6 bou6 faat3 zin2 ceot1 nung4 jip6 hai6 lik6 si2 hok6 gaa1 jin4 gau3 ge3 zung6 jiu3 fo3 tai4
